title: anthropics/commerce-agents
why_read: An official reference architecture from Anthropic for building commerce-focused agentic systems, useful for engineers designing production LLM agent pipelines in retail/commerce domains.
analysis: This is a reference blueprint from Anthropic showing concrete patterns for building shopping and merchant agents with Claude across retail, telecom, and entertainment use cases, which is valuable as a real-world architecture reference rather than a toy demo. Given Anthropic's authority on Claude's capabilities, the design patterns here (tool use, agent orchestration, domain-specific workflows) are likely to be genuinely instructive for engineers building similar production systems. It's vendor-specific but substantive as an engineering reference.
